What Is Ipamorelin?

Ipamorelin is a selective pentapeptide ghrelin-receptor (GHS-R1a) agonist studied for its high selectivity relative to earlier growth-hormone-releasing peptides in GPCR pharmacology research.

Research Background

Ipamorelin's receptor selectivity has made it a common tool compound in comparative GHS-R1a signaling studies, isolating growth-hormone secretagogue pathways from cortisol/ACTH cross-reactivity seen with older GHRPs.

How Ipamorelin Compares to Related Research Compounds

description_html:
What Is AHK-Cu?

AHK-Cu (Ala-His-Lys-Cu) is a copper-binding tripeptide complex closely related to GHK-Cu, studied in extracellular-matrix (ECM) and metalloenzyme signaling research.

Research Background

Research literature on copper tripeptide complexes has examined their role as cofactors in copper-dependent enzymatic reactions and as tools for studying matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) and collagen-related gene expression in cultured fibroblast models.

How AHK-Cu Compares to Related Research Compounds

  • GHK-Cu — a related compound frequently studied alongside AHK-Cu in comparative research designs.

Specifications

CompoundAHK-Cu 100mg
CAS number682809-81-0
Molecular formulaC15H24ClCuN6O4
Molecular weight451.39 g/mol
SequenceAHK
FormLyophilized powder (unless otherwise noted)
Purity≥98% (HPLC)
Intended useLaboratory research only
StorageStore lyophilized material at -20°C long-term or 2-8°C short-term, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only.

Preparing a Laboratory Stock Solution

For in-vitro assay preparation, researchers calculate a target concentration (mg/mL) from the vial's labeled mass and the volume of sterile diluent added, then aliquot and store per standard laboratory cold-chain practice. This is a laboratory dilution calculation only, performed strictly for analytical or in-vitro research purposes. Not for use in humans or animals.

Storage & Handling

Lyophilized powder should be stored at -20°C for long-term stability, or refrigerated (2-8°C) for short-term use, protected from light and moisture. Once reconstituted for laboratory use, follow standard cold-chain handling and use within the timeframe indicated by your institution's protocols.

Third-Party Verification

AHK-Cu ships with a QR-linked, batch-specific certificate of analysis (COA) confirming identity and purity via HPLC. Researchers should always confirm the lot number on their vial matches the COA on file before beginning any assay.

Sourcing & Quality

This reference material is manufactured and quality-tested to support reproducible research outcomes. Every batch is independently verified before it ships, and COAs remain accessible for future reference.

References

  • PubChem — chemical identity reference for CAS 682809-81-0.
  • Certificate of Analysis (COA) — batch-specific third-party purity and identity verification, linked from this product's order history.
  • How to read a Certificate of Analysis

For laboratory research use only. Not for use in humans or animals.
